review.notes: Completed a distinct reread of all 240 question rationales and axis boundaries after drafting. Rechecked current presidency, 2026 AI enforcement and grace period, genetic/experiential clinical guidance, official-secrets restriction, treaty withdrawal, multilingual signs, airport reclamation and overseas missions. Corrected drug-law citation and CCTV retention; added literal signage and treaty evidence; withdrew prolonged foreign combat and negotiated capability-reduction answers when sources established only presence or prospective revival. Culture/Nature 02/03/05/07/08/10/13/14/15 remain unknown; no generic education, equal-rights or party-label substitution. Its supported answers are explicitly limited clinical-domain interaction inferences, with ADHD’s documented strong inherited contribution and gender-pay institutional barriers. All numerical answers use the supplied question direction without target vectors or copying another profile. Other precise gaps remain in preventive movement restrictions before any offence, Indigenous questions, burqa-specific exception, housing-driven immigration cuts, current land redistribution, official-ceremony worship, parental sex-education veto, identity language, institutional gradualism and healthy cognitive implants. Parent agent still needs independent review. Flag File page, creator and public-domain notices checked; downloaded 960x640 PNG visually inspected. Validation results to be appended. No neighbour comparison is available because unresolved answers prevent score generation. Manual structure check confirmed 240 unique question IDs, 15 complete briefs and counterevidence entries, no dangling source IDs, and a 960x640 PNG below 1 MB. No archive, catalogue generation, build or browser verification was performed by this assigned agent. Distinct completion challenge on 2026-10-05: checked each new estimate against the exact statement and earlier withdrawn-evidence rationale. School curriculum is not a parental veto; ordinary local government is not Indigenous jurisdiction; unmanned/AI equipment does not verify autonomous lethal permission; no-fly-zone proposals are not implemented capability reduction; service finance does not establish income-transfer earmarking. Causal estimates retain the distinction between learned conduct and comparative hereditary primacy, group versus individual causes, and body image versus attraction. Read all neutral entries on warning-prone axes separately: treaties with domestic sovereignty, mixed sectoral trade/technology rules, unequal family recognition with specific support, and interacting causal mechanisms justify retained conditional choices. Same-agent review only; no independent human or second-agent review claimed.
